name: 2017 anomaly sensitivity analysis for green-cover response

first_difference_sensitivity.construction: True adjacent-year differences are created on the full 2015-2025 sequence before excluding anomaly transitions.

future_scenario_comparison.purpose: Compare response magnitude under full V3 coefficient versus no-2017 sensitivity coefficient only.

interpretation: V3S tests robustness to the anomalous 2017 year. It does not delete 2017 from the primary research pipeline and does not automatically replace the V3 primary coefficient.
causal_limit: All response estimates remain observational associations and are not guaranteed causal effects.
